articles.title: No Pixel 11, no problem: This app brings Gboard’s Rambler mode to any Android phone without root
articles.summary: TL;DR PixelBoard is a modded Gboard app that unlocks Rambler voice typing and writing tools on any Android phone. It doesn’t require root access and can be easily installed from GitHub. The developer has also stated that the app will be updated regularly as new Gboard versions are released. Among Gboard’s many useful features, a few aren’t available to non-Pixel users. One of these exclusive features is the impressive Rambler voice typing mode that recently debuted on the Pixel 11 series . However, if you’ve been itching to try it out on your Android phone and SwiftKey’s AI voice mode isn’t scratching that itch, there’s some good news for you. articles.title: LineageOS is getting an early Android 17 upgrade, and there’s plenty more to like
articles.summary: Credit: C. Scott Brown / Android Authority TL;DR LineageOS has announced its Android 17-based release earlier than expected, with LineageOS 24.0 ready for its initial rollout. The update refreshes several built-in apps, improves security patch support, and introduces browser-based tools to simplify the installation of the custom ROM. LineageOS is also improving accessibility and documentation ahead of its 10th anniversary on December 24, 2026. LineageOS is getting ready to bring Android 17 to more devices with its latest update. The new software also introduces redesigned apps, additional security patches, and new tools designed to make installing the custom ROM easier.

articles.summary: Elon Musk is a very familiar figure to Ars readers, given his massive influence (for better and worse) on the technology sector over the last 20 years. Oscar-winning director Alex Gibney's latest biographical documentary—simply titled Musk —covers a lot of well-known ground and challenges the carefully crafted public image of Musk as a visionary tech titan. articles.summary:
日本近期接連發生多起未經授權存取事件，並造成大量個資與其他資料外洩，日本電腦緊急應變團隊協調中心（JPCERT/CC）於10月8日發布警告指出，這波事件主要發生在2026年9月前後，並非都由單一漏洞或相同手法造成，而是涉及已知漏洞利用、API濫用、Metabase漏洞，以及在應用程式伺服器植入Web Shell等多種攻擊方式。
JPCERT/CC指出，受影響系統除了面向一般使用者的服務，也包括BI工具、員工管理系統等管理與營運系統。由於目前公開的技術資訊仍有限，因此此次整理近期掌握的4類攻擊手法與觀察結果。

articles.summary: 網際網路號碼分配局（IANA）宣布，DNS根區域（Root Zone）自10月11日起改由新金鑰KSK-2024負責簽署，取代原本的KSK-2017，這是繼2018年首次輪替後，時隔8年再次更換根區域金鑰。IANA提醒，啟用DNSSEC驗證卻未更新信任錨（Trust Anchor）的DNS解析器，可能無法驗證根區域資料，導致網域名稱解析失敗，但預期多數使用者不會受到影響。

articles.title: Startup Funding: Q3 2026
articles.summary: AI dominated funding in the third quarter of 2026, with two inference companies each announcing $1 billion in funding. But with the data center buildout driving insatiable demand for memory, investors also rewarded startups with alternatives to costly, capacity-limited HBM. Some are building on commodity DRAM or holding models in on-chip SRAM, while others stack memory directly onto compute. Data movement at all levels of the stack remains a critical bottleneck, too. Interconnect technologies, networking chips, and photonics were the most active areas of the quarter, with startups tackling the problem with diverse approaches ranging from manufacturing-ready co-packaged optics, millimeter-wave RF signals over plastic waveguides, and ferroelectric glass modulators to optical couplers printed

articles.title: Googlebook OS review: A post-smartphone PC, if Google can keep it
articles.summary: All attempts to bring the lessons and benefits of the touch era to PCs have failed, from Windows 8 to the era after the iPad when the Mac gained fullscreen apps. From an experience perspective, the iPad came closest because it was built on iOS, but it still failed due to the locked-down limitations at its core. After using Googlebook OS for over a week, I think Google has the beginnings of a desktop OS for the Android smartphone generation, but the inherent strategy reset makes for a rough first take. more…

After using Googlebook OS for over a week, I think Google has the beginnings of a desktop OS for the Android smartphone generation, but the inherent strategy reset makes for a rough first take. more…

articles.title: A recent Samsung change leaves some Galaxy phones stuck after updating
articles.summary: TL;DR Some Galaxy users report getting stuck on an XML “Access Denied” screen after updating to One UI 9. The issue appears during Samsung’s post-update setup, not during the update itself, so affected phones don’t appear to be truly bricked. Going fully offline, including disabling Wi-Fi and mobile data, has helped some users get past the error. Major Android updates are supposed to end with a tour of what’s new, not leave you wondering whether your phone has just become an expensive paperweight. Unfortunately, that is exactly the scare some Galaxy owners are getting after installing One UI 9 , with reports of devices becoming effectively stuck during Samsung’s post-update welcome process. According to reports we’ve seen on Reddit , the problem appears after the update installs successful

articles.title: Google TV bug is causing the UI to get a little jumpy
articles.summary: TL;DR Google TV users report that the screen bounces when navigating in apps-only mode. The issue is affecting Google TV Streamer, the Onn 4k Pro, and Google TVs. Google hasn’t addressed the issue, but there are some ways to get around the problem. Google TV’s apps-only mode is made to simplify the home screen by stripping away everything but the apps you’ve chosen for a fuss-free streaming experience. But a new UI bug that makes the entire screen jump when selecting an app is now frustrating users. On Reddit’s Google TV sub, a user posted a video of themselves navigating through apps in apps-only mode. Each press of the button results in the screen bouncing up and down. They report that the issue is happening on the two Google TV Streamer devices that they own with software version UTTK.2

articles.title: Your next Android flagship might just get a cooling fan built in
articles.summary: Credit: Nick Fernandez / Android Authority TL;DR Leaker Digital Chat Station says that adding a cooling fan to last year’s Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 gives better gaming/sustained performance than just the latest Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 SoC. Adding a cooling fan to the latest Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 SoC gives significantly better performance. Another Android brand is exploring adding a cooling fan to its Pro Max flagship, though it’s not immediately clear which brand this is. Smartphone SoCs have grown more powerful every year, to the point where it’s practically necessary to equip any phone with a flagship SoC with vapor chamber cooling. Without vapor-chamber cooling, flagship SoCs will throttle quickly after their peak, yielding performance that looks good only on paper.

articles.title: Overwhelming OnePlus 16 interest proves hardware was never the issue
articles.summary: I mourned OnePlus’s loss in the US. We need more smartphone competition stateside, not less, and the company’s departure felt like a capitulation. The retreat was especially frustrating because it didn’t stem from a string of poor products. OnePlus fans seem to agree, and plenty of attention has focused on the upcoming overseas release of the OnePlus 16. A recent Android Authority reader poll showed that 93% of respondents would buy the new OnePlus 16 if it were widely available in the US. It’s not surprising, and if you’ve ever used one of their phones, you know why.

Samsung produces a wide variety of devices across all price points, primarily under the Galaxy brand. Many of these phones are well worth the money, but 2026 is proving to be a difficult year for many smartphone manufacturers. As we’ve already seen with Motorola , the RAM crisis has forced many players to raise pricing while offering little new in exchange. Samsung is no different here. Below are just five models Samsung sells that I would caution against buying right now.

articles.title: Google is working on a simpler, faster way to use Gmail’s ‘Help Me Write’ feature
articles.summary: TL;DR Google is working to make Gmail’s “Help Me Write” feature easier to access and use. When composing a new email, Gmail could start showing a “Describe your message” prompt box by default. It could also let users switch between generated drafts with dedicated undo and redo buttons. Since it first launched the “Help Me Write” feature in Gmail, Google has steadily improved it to make drafts easier to edit , adapt to the way you normally write, and even scan your Drive files and previous emails for relevant context. However, using it still involves several steps, introducing unnecessary friction. Now, it seems Google is finally working to fix that. You’re reading an Authority Insights story. articles.title: This new Android weather app solves my biggest complaint about Pixel Weather
articles.summary: It’s no secret that Pixel Weather’s primary weakness — the inability for users to pick a preferred weather data provider — is one that many Android weather apps, like Breezy and Weather Master , circumvent. However, even if you choose a reliable weather model that feeds your app’s forecasts, there remains a degree of error. Forecasting weather is a game of percentages. They’re projections based on current conditions and long-term data. They’re not exact, underlined confirmations of why the sky might do, they’re effectively educated guesses.

articles.title: I’ve had a bad 48 hours using Googlebooks, but there’s one saving grace
articles.summary: I expected growing pains when I fully switched to the Acer Googlebook 14 as my only work machine. Even still, nothing could’ve prepared me for the state of Googlebook OS on the laptop that showed up at my door last week. Between the downgrades compared to ChromeOS , the disappointing Chrome browser , and the “Better Together” feature bugs , I’ve spent as much time troubleshooting this Googlebook as I’ve spent using it to get work done. Amid my struggles, I found something that Googlebook OS genuinely does better than ChromeOS, macOS, and Windows: it’s the most touch-friendly desktop operating system I’ve ever used, and it’s no coincidence that every Googlebook has a touchscreen .

articles.title: Google paid $90,000 for this bug, then waited two months to fix it
articles.summary: Google took two months to patch an unauthenticated RCE vulnerability in its developer documentation infrastructure. The problem was a reused OAuth client secret: DevSite stored it in a Flask session cookie and used it to sign sessions. Anyone who recovered the secret could forge a valid cookie and execute Python code on the server. Simon Köck , a software engineer at Otark GmbH, discovered the flaw in Google’s DevSite infrastructure, which is the shared platform behind developers.google.com plus several sibling documentation sites. Köck says the same signing secret worked across seven Google domains, although he publicly documents code execution only on developers.google.com. articles.title: Andrej Karpathy says only 5,000 people have seen what AI can really do
articles.summary: OpenAI founding member Andrej Karpathy , who joined Anthropic in May , thinks most of the world has little idea of what AI can do, and in a Sunday post on X , he said the gap is getting wider. By his own napkin math, roughly 6 billion people have barely used an LLM, 1 to 2 billion use chatbots casually, about 20 million use frontier models professionally in math and code, and around 5,000 have access to frontier systems inside the labs. Box CEO Aaron Levie sees an opportunity in that gap. “This is a good way to understand how early we actually are in AI diffusion right now,” he wrote in his response on X . He argued that most people still think of AI as a chatbot or a next-generation search engine while barely exploring its more advanced opportunities. Box bets on agent swarms

articles.title: After a 10-year redemption arc, No Man's Sky is coming to the iPhone and iPad

It will run on devices as far back as the iPhone 11 and the third-generation iPad Air. No Man's Sky might not have the most cutting-edge AAA graphics (though they're still strong, and they've come a long way since launch via updates), but the game's uncommon method of generating galaxies of incomprehensible scale on device consistently for all players from a single-seed happening on a phone is remarkable for those of us who remember phones performing far behind consoles or desktop PCs. articles.title: Google announces the Fitbit Edge, a middle ground between Pixel Watch 5 and Fitbit Air
articles.summary: Google is releasing its second Fitbit tracker of 2026, offering fans of the aging Charge 6 a more refined option. The new Fitbit Edge slots right in between the Pixel Watch 5 and the Fitbit Air , featuring a compact screen and more health sensors than the Air. You won't get all the apps and features of the Pixel Watch 5, but the Edge is only about half as expensive. The Fitbit Edge is essentially a new Charge 6, but it has more of a Pixel Watch aesthetic. Squish Google's smartwatch from the sides, and you've got the Edge. It has a pill-shaped 1.34-inch OLED touch display inside a slender aluminum frame that is rated IP68 (5 ATM) for water and dust protection. Google says the screen has 46 percent more viewable area compared to the Charge 6. It's very close in overall size to the Fitbit Air

articles.title: Amazon has over 1 million robot workers. What’s next for human employees?
articles.summary: No organization in the world operates more robots than Amazon. articles.title: Bun內建TypeScript型別檢查，官方測速最高達微軟編譯器6.4倍
articles.summary:
JavaScript執行環境Bun推出1.4.3版，新增內建TypeScript型別檢查器bun check，開發者可在執行程式、測試或建置前先檢查型別，發現錯誤就停止後續作業。Bun公布的測試顯示，檢查速度達TypeScript 7.0.2編譯器的3至6.4倍，記憶體用量也較低。
Bun原本就能直接執行TypeScript程式，但不會事先檢查資料型別是否正確，像是函式要求傳入數字，開發者卻提供字串，過去Bun不會在執行前報錯。新版加入型別檢查後，可在程式執行前找出這類問題，並顯示發生錯誤的檔案、位置及原因。

articles.title: 微軟Decision-1專攻AI代理決策，準確率83.5%領先同類模型
articles.summary: 微軟推出決策模型Microsoft-Decision-1，專門處理AI代理及企業應用中的分類、評分、工作分派與流程控管。模型可根據預先設定的選項進行判斷，並回傳各選項的機率，協助應用程式決定下一步行動，例如選擇適合的AI模型、檢查代理操作，或判斷是否需要人工審查。目前已透過Microsoft Foundry及OpenRouter提供服務。

articles.title: 數發部推數位核銷服務網，推動社福補助核銷流程自動化，並開源供其他機關重複利用
articles.summary:
為減輕社福團體的補助核銷行政作業負載。數發部今天（10/12）發表「數位核銷服務網」推動成果，數發部與衛福部社會及家庭署聯手，將AI導入社福團體的政府補助核銷作業，運用OCR與AI辨識發票、收據等單據，自動擷取資料、協助完成核銷文件整理與檢核，首波應用於社福補助及公益彩券補助案件，藉此降低大量人工登打及核對作業。
數發部表示，目前不少政府補助案件仍仰賴紙本單據及人工核銷，社福團體在申請補助後，需整理大量發票、收據、交通費及活動支出，再逐筆輸入核銷資料，不僅耗時，還容易因為人工登打發生錯誤。根據統計，每年約有1,300家社福團體、4千人次，約15億元的補助核銷作業。
